content.text: Almost. Health Canada's guidance is to start solids around 6 months, and Theo is 5 months. Until then, breast milk or formula is all he needs. You'll know he's ready when he sits with little support, holds his head steady, and reaches for your food. For now, you can let him watch you eat and hold a spoon to get him used to it. Confirm timing with your provider or public health.
